info.title: Cronlight
info.description: The API of the Cronlight dashboard for Quartz.NET. Requests are authorized as the dashboard is, by the host's ViewPolicy and ManagePolicy. Requests that change jobs must send an X-Cronlight-Request header (any value), which keeps other sites from using a viewer's cookies. Every request may name a scheduler with ?scheduler=, and goes to the host's own scheduler without it. Errors are problem details, whose detail says what is wrong.

get.summary: Searches, filters and pages the jobs
get.description: search matches names and groups; type is a job type label; status is Active, Paused, Unloadable or Error. Pages hold 50 jobs unless pageSize says otherwise, at most 200. The counts are over every job, whatever the filters. With history on, each job carries its last 10 runs (recentRuns), newest first, each by its final outcome.

get.summary: Runs by outcome, success rate and durations over a period
get.description: The period is the last 24 hours unless hours, or from and to, say otherwise, at most 90 days. group and name pick one job's runs, and status one outcome. A run is counted by its outcome, a retried attempt as a retry; durations are over attempts that ran, and the median and P95 by nearest rank. 404 when execution history is not enabled.

post.summary: Imports jobs from a JSON or YAML file
post.description: Creates the file's jobs the scheduler does not have and updates the others to match it; never deletes a job. Every job is checked before any is changed: if one cannot be imported, none is, and the 400 answer lists each job's problem under jobs. dryRun=true answers with what importing would do, and changes nothing. Send YAML as application/yaml.
